component.name: Kora
component.summary: Browse and play music from Lyrion Music Server

description.p: Kora is a GTK4 and libadwaita client for Lyrion Music Server, formerly Logitech Media Server. Browse your library, radio, apps and favorites, control and sync every player on the network, and listen on this computer through the built-in output or a managed Squeezelite.
Album pages can be shown as a list as well as a grid.
